gloss: to yield, to submit, to succumb

definitions.gloss: to yield, to submit, to succumb, to give in
definitions.explanation: To surrender or submit to a force, power, or pressure. Often used for yielding to authority, temptation, or overwhelming circumstances.

examples.japanese: {圧力|あつりょく}に{屈|くっ}する
{彼|かれ}は{脅迫|きょうはく}に{屈|くっ}しなかった。
examples.english: He did not yield to the threats.

examples.japanese: {困難|こんなん}に{屈|くっ}することなく、{最後|さいご}まで{戦|たたか}い{続|つづ}けた。
examples.english: Without yielding to hardship, they continued to fight to the end.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive ({自動詞|じどうし}). Takes に particle: ～に{屈|くっ}する.

CONJUGATION: {サ|さ}{変|へん}{動詞|どうし} (irregular する verb): {屈|くっ}しない, {屈|くっ}します, {屈|くっ}して.

NUANCE: {屈|くっ}する is a formal word that implies giving in or surrendering to a stronger force. Often used in negative constructions ({屈|くっ}しない) to express determination or resolve.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {圧力|あつりょく}に{屈|くっ}する (to yield to pressure)
- {脅迫|きょうはく}に{屈|くっ}する (to succumb to threats)
- {権力|けんりょく}に{屈|くっ}する (to submit to authority)
- {誘惑|ゆうわく}に{屈|くっ}する (to give in to temptation)
- {屈|くっ}しない{精神|せいしん} (indomitable spirit)

RELATED WORDS:
- {負|ま}ける (to lose, give in - more common)
- {従|したが}う (to follow, obey)
- {降伏|こうふく}する (to surrender - military context)
